title: PROJECT.yaml
description: Claude Code project configuration schema. Defines project identity, tech stack, testing, deployment, secrets, and integrations.

name.description: Project name used in container naming, CI job names, and secret paths

version_file.description: Legacy version file path (VERSION, package.json, pyproject.toml). Omit to use git tags (recommended)

version_source.description: How version is determined. git-tags (recommended): derived from conventional commits. file: read from version_file

languages.description: Programming languages used in the project

components.description: Project components for monorepos or multi-service projects

docs_dir.description: Project documentation directory path relative to project root. Defaults to 'docs' if not set. Used by task management, doc utilities, and all scripts that create/read documentation.

language.description: A programming language used in the project

name.description: Language name (e.g., python, typescript, javascript, go, rust)

root.description: Root directory for this language's code (e.g., src, backend, frontend)

component.description: A project component (service, module, or sub-project)

framework.description: Framework used (e.g., fastapi, nextjs, nestjs, mcp)

internal_port.description: Internal port the service listens on

test_target.description: Make target for pre-merge testing (e.g., test-backend-unit). If unset, falls back to test-{name}

lint_target.description: Make target for pre-merge linting (e.g., lint-backend). If unset, falls back to lint-{name}

command.description: Primary test command (e.g., pytest, npm test, make test)

coverage_command.description: Coverage report command (e.g., pytest --cov, npm run test:coverage)

e2e_command.description: End-to-end test command (e.g., playwright test, cypress run)

ecr_namespace.description: ECR namespace prefix for image repos (e.g., 'nuvia' -> nuvia/project/service)

services.description: Expected Docker service names for health checks

registry.description: Flat registry config (use this OR environments, not both)

environments.description: Per-environment Docker config (use this OR flat registry, not both)

profile.description: Docker Compose profile for this environment

platform.description: CI/CD platform (auto-detected from git remote if empty)

backend.description: Secrets backend (aws for macOS/work, infisical for Linux/home)

required.description: Secret bucket names this project uses

interval_seconds.description: How often to check for updated secrets (default: 300)

type.description: Refresh type: inline (memory) or file (env file rewrite)

cache_driver.description: Cache driver for inline refresh (e.g., redis, file, database)

template_dir.description: Directory containing .env templates for file-based refresh

target_files.description: Target .env files to write for file-based refresh

restart_command.description: Command to restart the service after file refresh

rebuild_command.description: Command to rebuild after file refresh

purpose.description: Purpose description (e.g., main, cache, queue, storage)

secret_keys.description: Key names within the JSON secret (NOT actual values)

databaseMigrations.description: Database migration configuration. The per-DB runtime details (tool, path, command) are encoded as conventions in the project (e.g., typeorm.config.<db-name>.prod.js) — this schema only tracks the on/off flag.

enabled.description: Whether migrations are enabled for this database

method.description: Deployment method: pipeline (CI/CD), script (local), ssh (direct), ssm (AWS Systems Manager)

strategy.description: Deployment strategy. blue-green: deploy to inactive color and swap. staging-production: promote through staging first. prod-only: deploy directly to production. none: no deployment configured

active.description: Currently active color for blue-green deployments. Deployments target the inactive color

region.description: Default AWS region for deployment operations (default: us-west-1)

cloudflare.description: Cloudflare DNS settings (used by dns-cutover.sh for blue/green DNS switching)

zone_id.description: Cloudflare zone ID for the domain

token_file.description: Path to file containing Cloudflare API token (default: ~/.cloudflare)

ip_access.description: Whether agents use private or public IPs to reach instances (private = inside VPC)

url.description: Base URL for health checks and E2E tests

public_url.description: Public-facing URL for domain accessibility checks

domain.description: Primary domain for this environment (non-blue-green single-instance deployments)

roving_domain.description: Floating domain that points to the active instance in blue-green deployments

private_ip.description: Private IP for non-blue-green single-instance deployments

public_ip.description: Public IP for non-blue-green single-instance deployments

nginx_ssl_domain.description: SSL certificate domain for nginx configuration

nginx_server_name.description: Space-separated server names for nginx server_name directive

firebase_project.description: Firebase project ID for this environment

containers.description: Container names expected in this environment

blue.description: Blue instance configuration for blue-green deployments

green.description: Green instance configuration for blue-green deployments

blueGreenInstance.description: Instance configuration for one side of a blue-green deployment

public_ip.description: Public IP address for external access

domain.description: Direct domain for this specific instance

url.description: Direct URL for this instance (for health checks before swap)

target.description: Target identifier (instance ID, service name, etc.)

smokeTests.description: Smoke test configuration for post-deployment validation

public_endpoints.description: Endpoints that must be accessible from public IPs (legacy shape)

private_endpoints.description: Endpoints restricted to private IPs only (legacy shape)

containers.description: Docker container names that must report healthy

endpoints.description: Health/API endpoints checked via docker exec (--server mode)

external_endpoints.description: Endpoints checked from CI via domain (--full mode)

browser_tests.description: Browser smoke tests (Playwright). Pipeline reads mode and runs accordingly.

mode.description: disabled: skip all. smoke: run frontend/e2e/smoke/. list: run only specs listed below. all: run frontend/e2e/.

specs.description: Spec paths to run (used only when mode: list)

check_path.description: Endpoint path that returns the version in its JSON response

field.description: JSON field name containing the version string

dockerExecEndpoint.description: Endpoint checked from inside the Docker network via docker exec

url.description: URL to fetch from inside the container (typically 127.0.0.1:port)

runtime.description: Runtime used to execute the curl-equivalent inside the container

severity.description: warning: failure logged but doesn't fail the smoke test

externalEndpoint.description: Endpoint checked externally (from CI) via domain

path.description: Path appended to the deployment domain

fields.description: JSON fields and expected values (supports dot.notation paths)

contains.description: Substring expected in response body (HTML mode)

expect.description: Expected response type (html, status:200, json, etc.)

backend.description: Task management backend (asana, gitlab, or taskforge)

project_id.description: TaskForge project UUID for task operations

api_key_file.description: Path to file containing the API key (default: ~/.task-forge-key)

container.description: Docker container name for exec commands (default: task-forge-api-1)

section_id.description: Default section GID for new tasks

custom_fields.description: Custom field definitions for task management

project_id.description: GitLab project ID or owner/repo path

notifications.description: Notification configuration — supports CI/CD webhook format (provider/on_success/on_failure/channel) or app-level format (enabled/events/channels)

provider.description: CI/CD webhook notification provider (determines payload format)

channel.description: Channel/room for notifications (documentation — routing configured in webhook)

events.description: Events to notify on, with channel list per event

secret_key.description: Key name for webhook URL in secret
Key name for webhook URL in secret
Key name for email API key/credentials

infrastructure.description: Infrastructure configuration (separate repos, symlinks, IaC tools)

enabled.description: Whether this project has infrastructure configuration

check_link.description: Verify symlink points to correct location

target.description: Symlink name in project root (default: infrastructure)

source.description: Path within infra repo to link

path.description: Path to tool configuration within infra repo

schemaSync.description: Schema sync to Open Metadata configuration. Automatically syncs database schema changes to Open Metadata during production deploys with AI-generated field descriptions.

enabled.description: Enable schema sync. If false or missing, schema sync is skipped entirely.

url.description: Open Metadata instance URL (e.g., https://catalog.example.com). Token comes from OPEN_METADATA_TOKEN secret, not PROJECT.yaml.

exclude_tables.description: Tables to exclude from schema capture (framework internals like migrations, typeorm_metadata)

ai.description: AI description generation configuration. Context is injected into the prompt to help the model generate accurate, domain-relevant descriptions.

domain.description: Project domain for AI context (e.g., healthcare, e-commerce, internal operations)

context.description: Project-specific context injected into the AI description prompt. Describe what the application does, who uses it, and what kind of data the databases contain.
